text:
maria: Week-ahead rotation heatcheck — who needs the model onboarding slot this week? posting to sync capacity and quick handoffs. :wave:
aj: I have a quant experiment for 'lyra-lite' — needs a GPU slot for 6h, priority low-medium. Will need off-peak window.
kai: Heads-up: we also have a regression alert on raven-55b that might require a short rollback test if we plan to push baseline changes. probably needs 2h. :eyes:
sam: FYI product wants a demo for dedicated customer on Wed afternoon — they'd like a stable 65b variant available. high priority for that slot.
maria: OK — can we fit demo + regression + quant into the rotation? current free windows: Tue 18:00-23:00, Wed 09:00-12:00, Thu 02:00-05:00 (PST).
sasha: tagging infra — @rotations-bot can you confirm GPU pool availability for those windows?
rotations-bot: pools status: gpu-pool-1=60% used, gpu-pool-2=40% used, preemptible=15% used. Tue evening and Thu early morning look good; Wed morning has a backlog.
aj: If Wed is busy, I can move quant to Tue 18:30. I can also cut experiment length to 3h if needed.
kai: Regression investigation could be staged — run smoke on Tue 19:00 for 30m, then full rollback test Thu 02:30 if smoke fails.
maria: Plan suggestion: Tue 18:30-21:30 = aj quant (short), Tue 19:00-19:30 overlap smoke for raven (kai), Wed 09:00-11:00 = product demo prep + dry run (sam), Thu 02:30-03:30 = full regression rollback test (kai). Anyone object?
sam: Works for me. I'll prep canned prompts and a quick evaluation rubric for the demo.
aj: fine. also leaving a short checklist for onboarding slot handoff:
```
- upload model tarball to s3://onboard-staging/lyra-lite/
- verify model signature and metadata schema
- create run config: batch=auto, kv_cache=true, quant=ptq-8
- smoke test: 10 requests, max latency 300ms
- capture perf profile and attach to PR
```
maria: Couple of notes — set `quant=ptq-8` only if perf delta <15% on LlamaEval suite. If quality regressed >2% on top-1, revert to fp16 and mark for further tuning.
kai: I can run a quick eval after aj's run and post numbers. will add the eval checklist to the thread output.
sasha: infra: reserving Tue 18:30-21:30 on gpu-pool-2; Wed 09:00-11:00 on gpu-pool-1 tentative (will confirm by EOD), Thu 02:30 reserved on preemptible but with auto-fallback to pool-1.
maria: Great — thanks. I'll create a short ticket (onboard/2876543201) summarizing assignments and link to eval prompts. :thumbsup:
aj: thanks — ping me if anything changes.
kai: will post early smoke results here.
sam: prepping demo dataset now.
maria: Closing note: whoever owns the final artifacts, please push perf JSON + eval CSV to the ticket and @maria when done.
